text.tspan: Taints repel, affinity attracts: dedicated nodes need both
Taint effects: NoSchedule · PreferNoSchedule · NoExecute (also evicts running pods).
Not-ready nodes get a NoExecute taint; pods tolerate it for 300 s, then they are evicted.
Spread replicas across AZs: topologySpreadConstraints on topology.kubernetes.io/zone, maxSkew 1.
a toleration allows, it doesn't attract
